points.quote: stretching the attack from seconds of flooding to hours
points.problem: The revised paragraph says the patch stretched the attack from seconds to hours (a patched resolver poisoned in under ten hours), but the Fig 11.7 caption (ch11-dns-p8) still says Kaminsky's attack took minutes and the fix pushed it 'from minutes to years'. The two figures of merit contradict each other within the same section.
points.hint: Align the ch11-dns-p8 caption wording (minutes to years) with the seconds-to-hours account, or drop one of the two.

points.quote: which is why the walled-garden services (AOL, CompuServe, MSN) all ended up opening onto the web
points.problem: States a single cause as fact: the public-domain release is said to be why AOL, CompuServe and MSN ended up opening onto the web. Their opening up was driven mainly by user demand and the web's own growth; the release is at most one contributing factor.
points.hint: Soften to 'one reason' or 'helps explain', or drop the causal clause.
